en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large spa/kurhaus building bordered by gardens and a tree‑lined path, with a person walking in the foreground. Caption at the bottom reads "Bad Pyrmont" and "Staatl. Kurhaus." The reverse has standard address lines, the German printing note "Echte Kupfertiefdruckkarte," a blue stamp "Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont," and a small oval printer's mark from Dortmund with a serial number.
